spanish: Y ahora, maten todo macho en el niño, y toda mujer conociente varón a yacer de macho, maten.

findings.issue: בַּטָּף is the definite collective little-ones; 'el niño' is one child, so 'todo macho en el niño' moves the males from among that group into a single child.
Feminine singular qal participle 'knowing' is smoothed into the nonstandard 'conociente'; the woman remains the one who knows.
Construct noun לְמִשְׁכַּב (bed/lying) plus זָכָר is smoothed to the infinitive 'a yacer de macho'; the lying-of-a-male relation remains.

notes: Imperatives stay 2pl ustedes 'maten', and the repeated kill and both זָכָר are kept.
